summary_en: SERAKU will cancel 170,000 treasury shares on November 10, 2026, representing 1.25% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares will total 13,390,000.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On October 29, 2026, SERAKU's board of directors resolved to cancel 170,000 treasury shares pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, effective November 10, 2026. The cancellation represents 1.25% of issued shares prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, total issued shares will number 13,390,000, and treasury shares will total 371,605 shares, equivalent to 2.78% of post-cancellation issued shares.
